$description: Instrument: the design tokens of NCode's look and feel, NCode Brand 0.1.0. Generated by build.mjs from src/tokens.source.json; do not edit it. Primitives are at the top level. The semantic colors and shadows are under "light" and "dark", resolved for NCode's own brand; a token a tenant's colors change carries its rule in $extensions. A group that sets a tier names it in its $extensions, and the groups inside it inherit it: "semantic" is the public contract, "primitive" is private.

brand.description: primaryColor: what you press. Keys, links, focus, selection.

brand-secondary.description: secondaryColor: what you are shown. Screens and the tenant's scope braces. It follows the primary until a tenant sets it.

blue.$description: Blue: the logo kit's hue, 225 degrees in HSL. 300, 600 and 900 are the kit's exact colors; the other steps bend the hue the way those three do.

stone.$description: Stone: the neutral. A trace of warm olive (OKLCH hue 106), so the case has no opinion about a tenant's color.

amber.$description: Amber: the one supporting hue. Warning, hazard tape, and a sensitive value on a screen.

mono.$description: every value the system reports, and code

width.$description: Width is part of the voice: labels are engraved narrow, headings a little condensed, text at full width.

code.$description: Martian Mono at 75% has a 0.6em advance, the usual width of a code face

readout.$description: a short value on a screen is set wide, like a display

travel.$description: how far a key stands above its plate, and how far it moves when pressed

measure.$description: the reading column of long-form documentation: about 70 characters at the reading size

bleed.$description: how far a listing or a table starts before the reading column, so its content lines up with the text

breakpoint.$description: Media queries cannot read custom properties, so base.css repeats these numbers; they are exported for a Material UI theme's breakpoints.

phone.$description: 640px: below it tables become lists, dialogs become sheets and navigation moves into a sheet

tablet.$description: 1088px: below it the console's navigation moves into a sheet

desk.$description: 1280px: below it documentation drops its page index

tick.description: a readout changes in one step; it never glides

brace.$description: The brace is drawn the way the mark's brace is: straight stems, circular hooks at the ends and a cusp of two arcs whose tip is half the stroke high. w is the stroke, r the hook's radius and c the cusp's, both on the centerline, and e the straight end of a hook, all in pixels. 'mark' is the mark's own brace in its 64-unit grid. The others take any height: their hooks and cusp keep their size and only the stems stretch. Their radii are about twice the mark's for the same stroke, so the shape still reads as a brace when the stems are long.

sm.note: a lifetime in a code listing

lg.note: the frame of a console workspace

sm.$description: the width of the sm brace: a lifetime in a code listing

md.$description: the width of the md brace: a card, the memory panel

lg.$description: the width of the lg brace: the frame of a console workspace

typography.$description: Type roles. Each names a family, a size, a line height, a weight, a width and a tracking from the primitives (or gives a number). tokens.css carries each as a font shorthand, --nc-type-<role>; width and tracking are set beside it.

headline.$description: the one headline of a landing page

title-long.$description: the title of a long-form page

heading-long.$description: a section of a long-form page

subheading.$description: a group within a section, the title of a dialog

lead.$description: the first paragraph of a long-form page

field.$description: the label of a field: sentence case, because a form is read, not scanned

label.$description: engraved: the name of a fixed part. Column heads, group heads, tags, the boundary's kind

value.$description: displayed: anything read off the system

readout.$description: a short value on a screen

light.$description: Semantic tokens, light theme, for NCode's own brand.

page-sunken.$description: a recess cut into the case

surface-raised.$description: the brightest sheet: a dialog, a menu, a page of documentation

surface-sunken.$description: a recess cut into a plate: a table head, a footer

ghost-hover.$description: the face a ghost key gains under the pointer: the text color, thinned

border.$description: a hairline between parts: decoration, it carries no meaning alone

border-strong.$description: the edge of a control: 3 to 1 against every surface in both themes

lamp-unlit.$description: an unlit lamp in a selector: decoration, the word and the latched key carry the state

lip.$description: the side of a raised part

shadow.$description: the only soft shadow, under overlays

primary.$description: NCode Blue becomes exactly NCode Blue Light in the dark theme

org.ncode.instrument.rule: light-dark(lch(from var(--nc-brand) clamp(0, (49.4 - l) * 9999, 100) 0 0), oklch(from var(--nc-brand) 0.205 min(c * 0.32, 0.076) calc(h + 2.4)))

on-primary.$description: white, or black when the tenant's color is lighter than CIE lightness 49.4, near where the label with the higher contrast changes. A color at the flip itself can fall short in CSS; tokens/derive.mjs chooses by measured contrast

primary-shade.$description: what a primary key's face moves toward when it is touched: away from its label, so the label gains contrast

org.ncode.instrument.rule: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), var(--nc-color-primary-shade) 13%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), var(--nc-color-primary-shade) 22%))
light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), var(--nc-color-primary-shade) 22%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), #000000 10%))
light-dark(oklch(from var(--nc-color-primary) min(l * 0.78, 0.55) calc(c * 0.78) h), color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), #000000 10%))

primary-edge.$description: the outline of a primary key: darker than its face, and never lighter than OKLCH lightness 0.55, so it reaches 3 to 1 against a light plate whatever the tenant's color

org.ncode.instrument.rule: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), #000000 40%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-color-primary), #000000 48%))
light-dark(oklch(from var(--nc-brand) min(l, 0.48) c h), var(--nc-color-primary))

primary-text.$description: the brand as text, line or lamp: at most OKLCH lightness 0.48 in the light theme, 4.5 to 1 on every surface for all but the brightest greens, which tokens/derive.mjs darkens further

org.ncode.instrument.rule: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-stone-0), var(--nc-color-primary) 8%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-stone-925), var(--nc-color-primary) 16%))

primary-subtle.$description: the wash behind a selected option

org.ncode.instrument.rule: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-stone-0), var(--nc-color-primary) 30%), color-mix(in oklab, var(--nc-stone-925), var(--nc-color-primary) 42%))

screen-raised.$description: a lit row, a memory cell

screen-lit.$description: keywords, lit labels, the lit boundary plate, braces on a screen

org.ncode.instrument.rule: light-dark(oklch(from var(--nc-brand-secondary) min(l, 0.48) c h), var(--nc-color-screen-lit))

scope-tenant.$description: a tenant's braces take the tenant's secondary color

scope-team.$description: a team's braces are plain ink

scope-platform.$description: the platform's braces are hazard tape: this color striped with on-hazard

shadow.$description: Box shadows. Offsets and blurs in pixels; a color is a semantic color.

dark.$description: Semantic tokens, dark theme, for NCode's own brand.
